judgment_policy: Human/model semantic judgments derived from the authoritative corpus. Gold v3 separates benchmark-anchor disposition from current semantic-state coverage. anchor_disposition scores whether the original benchmark source should itself be retained, omitted, or suppressed because it is superseded. state_retain says whether the durable state must exist somewhere. coverage_sources enumerates user-authoritative source nodes that may satisfy that state, with source-specific authority/grounding expectations when they differ. Provenance and content guards remain mechanical; semantic_target equivalence still requires human/model judgment. Grounding may resolve referents only and may not add semantic detail.

metrics.anchor_fidelity: Exact benchmark source disposition only; alternate authority does not count here.
metrics.state_coverage: For state_retain=true, at least one explicitly allowed coverage source produced a Memory.
metrics.omit_cleanliness: For state_retain=false, the benchmark source produced no Memory.
metrics.semantic_target: Manual/model judgment of the Memory body; never inferred from source selection alone.

selection_policy: Routine tuning subset chosen for measured failure-mode coverage with minimal model spend: short/deictic adoption; grounding and correction; asserted tag questions versus pure questions; execution receipts and mixed receipt/status; transient phase metadata; supersession/over-atomization; long governing architecture; future modality; and simple direct-state sanity. Source-node IDs and content are unchanged; conversation/Episode IDs are fixture-local. Full gold v3 remains the confirmation suite.
